name: Okura (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Okura village emblem in white: a crown-like device above a ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Okura, a village in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 February 1965.

features.role: Okura village emblem — a crown-like device above a ring, like a stylised character
